name: Pilbara Lithium Corridor
rationale: Known pegmatite belts, strong road/port access, and stable permitting create a high-confidence target zone.

name: Katanga Cobalt Belt
rationale: Exceptional mineral evidence is offset by infrastructure, regulatory, and social-risk constraints.

name: Mountain Pass Rare Earth Trend
rationale: Carbonatite geology, domestic policy support, and existing processing interest make this a strategic resilience target.

name: Sulawesi Nickel Laterite Arc
rationale: Strong laterite potential and processing build-out, with policy/export volatility requiring scenario monitoring.

name: Atacama Copper Porphyry Belt
rationale: World-class porphyry setting and export infrastructure, with water stress and permitting as key constraints.
